summary: PWA replaced by Electron native app
detail: Editor migrated from Chrome PWA to Electron wrapper with native IPC file system, atomic writes, auto-backup directory. PWA was a dead-end — browser permissions expire between sessions, no real standalone app experience.

summary: Electron + electron-builder added as core dependencies
detail: New runtime dependency on Electron for native macOS app. Build tooling via electron-builder for .app bundle distribution. Replaces browser-only deployment model.
